title: Overlapping Claims on an Enrolment and What a Withdrawal Holds Back
content:
Where several claims on a Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment name the same kind of loss, part of what a withdrawal would release is held back until it is settled which claim covers what.

- Where two or more claims on the enrolment name the same kind of loss as the one most recently opened and two or more claims were opened on the enrolment in the two months before, the release is taken at the marketplace's overlapping-claims share of 93 percent.
- Where two or more name the same kind of loss and fewer than two claims were opened in the two months before, it is taken at the marketplace's older-overlap share of 97 percent.
- Where fewer than two name the same kind of loss, nothing is held back on that account.

### How the reading falls

| Claims naming the same kind of loss as the most recent | Claims opened in the two months before | Release taken at |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 or more | 93 percent |
| 2 or more | fewer than 2 | 97 percent |
| fewer than 2 | either | the whole of it |

The claims naming the same kind of loss are counted over the whole life of the enrolment, while the second count is taken over the two months before.

### Worked reading (hypothetical figures)

On a release measured at 2000, the three readings give 1860.00, 1940.00 and 2000.00 respectively.
